title: DATEDIFF is negative when the first date is later
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", DATEDIFF ( DATE ( 2012, 1, 1 ), DATE ( 2011, 12, 31 ), DAY ) )

source.quote: It returns a negative result if Date1 is larger than Date2.
source.supports: a later first date gives a negative count

source.quote: Previous versions of the DAX engine (earlier than 2018) could provide an error if Date1 is larger than Date2.

derivation: From January 1, 2012 back to December 31, 2011 one day boundary is crossed, backwards: -1.
